name: saas-o-matic
description: SaaS-O-Matic - Dynamic Billing & Subscription Optimizer (Omatic Tech Demo)

scripts.install:all: npm --prefix mic-saas-omatic install && npm --prefix spa-saas-omatic install
scripts.start: concurrently -n "API,SPA" -c "blue,magenta" --kill-others-on-fail "npm --prefix mic-saas-omatic run start:dev" "npm --prefix spa-saas-omatic start"
scripts.test: npm run test:backend && npm run test:frontend
scripts.test:coverage: npm run test:coverage:backend && npm run test:coverage:frontend
scripts.lint: npm --prefix mic-saas-omatic run lint && npm --prefix spa-saas-omatic run lint
scripts.build: npm --prefix mic-saas-omatic run build && npm --prefix spa-saas-omatic run build
scripts.ci: npm run lint && npm run test && npm run build
scripts.ci:coverage: npm run lint && npm run test:coverage && npm run build
scripts.docker: docker compose down --remove-orphans && docker compose build --no-cache && docker compose up -d && docker compose ps
scripts.docker:quick: docker compose up -d --build && docker compose ps
scripts.docker:status: docker compose ps && docker compose logs --tail=20
